headline: Fairfax unit plans $370 million sale of 13.25% stake in India's IIFL Finance
summary: FIH Mauritius Investments announced plans to divest up to 5.65 crore shares, representing a 13.25% equity interest, in Indian non-bank lender IIFL Finance at 611 rupees per share.
why: IIFL Finance is a major Indian non-banking financial company (NBFC); large block transactions by strategic backers shift governance and institutional shareholding.

impacts.name: IIFL Finance
impacts.why: Shares jumped 6% following details of the planned secondary market stake placement at 611 rupees.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: IIFL Finance shares gained 6% after Fairfax's investment vehicle set the secondary placement price at 611 rupees.
